prose: The Guardian's live business blog reports global stocks tumbling as fears that the Democrats' midterm wave will sink the AI investment boom roil markets after heavy Wall Street losses. Asia-Pacific markets were 'a sea of red'. A trader quoted says clients 'got carried out', with margin calls, and describes the shift as a policy change that pauses and cools AI, data-center approvals and equity capital markets. The AI trade was already shakier: Magnificent Seven earnings undershot growth expectations, with signs AI spending is slowing.
highlights: Global stocks fall again on fears of tech regulation and data-center curbs
Asia-Pacific markets deeply in the red
Trader: margin calls and a 'six-year structural shift' to cool AI
Mag Seven earnings undershot; AI spending pace slowing
